en.title: Number of Words with the Same First and Last Letter
en.description:
The text consists of English-letter words and spaces. Count the words whose first letter is the same as their last letter, ignoring case. For empty text, output 0.

The statement, the case rule, and the empty-string example are explicit; this site adds the line-based input protocol.

Source: https://oamaster.com/docs/companies/koddi#1-count-words-starting-and-ending-with-same-letter (fixed statement fingerprint aabdd05da914ce83b29ae5f4754110f3f23b0ccb4c1d9097bb5ff5c7438e9310). The input/output protocol and bounds added by this site follow the statement and are not claimed to be the original site's rules.
en.input: A single line of text (possibly empty; at most 100000 characters), with words separated by one or more spaces.
en.output: Output the number of qualifying words.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for the full approach, proof, and complexity.
hints: Split the text into words on whitespace and compare each word's first and last letters after lowercasing.
